paper_title: Upper Limit on the QCD Axion Mass from Isolated Neutron Star Cooling
notes: Neutron star cooling limit on QCD axion. Primary result is upper limit on axion mass (m_a < 16 meV, KSVZ, 95% CL). The paper also quotes coupling limits: |g_ann| < 1.3e-9 (axion-neutron only) and |g_app| < 1.5e-9 (axion-proton only) at 95% CL. Extracted the axion-neutron limit (per hint). This is an astrophysical cooling bound, effectively flat over the relevant meV mass range; encoded as a horizontal two-point line spanning ~meV masses. There is also a full g_ann-g_app exclusion plane (Fig S5) not tabulated numerically. Confidence lowered because paper reports both neutron and proton couplings and the primary result is on m_a, not on the coupling. | selector: text (sole candidate)
